title: pydantic-core serializers: impl_py_gc_traverse! must list every field that holds Python refs or nested serializers
answers: memory leak / reference cycle not collected with model serializer extra fields
added a new field to a serializer struct in pydantic-core, what else must change?
why does the gc traversal test fail for a serializer
body:
Symptom: objects reachable only through a model/dataclass serializer (e.g. the serializer for `extra` fields) are not visited by Python's cyclic GC, so reference cycles through them leak.
Root cause: pydantic-core/src/serializers/fields.rs:GeneralFieldsSerializer had an `extra_serializer` field that was missing from its `impl_py_gc_traverse!` list (only `fields` and `computed_fields` were listed), and the macro call sat far from the struct definition, so the two drifted apart.
Fix pattern: add every field that holds Py objects or nested serializers to the `impl_py_gc_traverse!(Struct { ... })` invocation; keep the invocation right below the struct definition so new fields get noticed.
Constraints: any time you add or rename a field on a serializer/validator struct that holds Python objects (Py<...>, CombinedSerializer, Option/Box/maps of them), update its impl_py_gc_traverse! in the same change. Plain Rust data (usize, bools, strings) doesn't need to be listed. Upstream PR #13626 added a check that caught this omission.
applies: Rust structs in pydantic-core/src/serializers (and similar validator structs) that use impl_py_gc_traverse!
